item.title: Here's how Pennsylvania residents can check if they're owed unclaimed money
item.description: The Pennsylvania Treasury is alerting residents to check if they are owed free money from unclaimed property. The state is sending out nearly $100,000 in checks for so-called "unclaimed property" totaling more than $20M. The funds are part of Pennsylvania's ‘Money Match’ law that returns money to its rightful owner.
